description: This file contains unit tests for the DefaultMonitoringConfig class within the org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.messaging.config package. The tests verify immutability, equality/hashCode consistency, and correct loading of configuration values from 'monitoring-test' configuration files.

classes.name: DefaultMonitoringConfigTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DefaultMonitoringConfig, testing immutability, equality, and configuration value loading.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by loading the 'monitoring-test' configuration before all tests run.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the DefaultMonitoringConfig class and related classes are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Checks that DefaultMonitoringConfig has proper hashCode and equals implementations.

methods.name: underTestReturnsValuesOfConfigFile
methods.description: Tests that the configuration values loaded from the config file match expected values.
